cases.description: Twelve headings that are empty or hold only a closing sequence, white space, a no-break space, an anchor element or a code span of one space have empty slugs and no derived anchor, while the explicit anchor `e` is listed (steps 1 and 4, decision C14); GitHub gives `""`, `-1` and `-2` to the first three, `-` to the code span, which it does not trim, and no permalink to the rest.
